metadata.title: Master Model Training, Parameter & Validation Registry
metadata.source_foundation: GBIF Occurrence Records + EPPO Reporting + NASA POWER Agro-Climatology

split_architecture.test_split: 2024-05-01 to 2025-12-01 (20 Months Untouched Final Test, 200 Pathogen-Months)

hyperparameters.search_space: p in [1, 2, 3] with conditional least squares estimation
q in [1, 2, 3] via Maximum Likelihood Estimation

Additive vs Multiplicative trend/seasonality, damped damping parameter phi in [0.8, 0.98]

arimax.model_type: Autoregressive Moving Average with External Covariates

hyperparameters.search_space: ARIMA order (p,d,q) with 1-month lagged weather regressors

sarimax.model_type: Seasonal Vector State-Space Regression with Climate Covariates

hyperparameters.search_space: Seasonal Box-Jenkins with 3 lagged NASA weather regressors
learning_rate in [0.03, 0.05, 0.1], max_depth in [3, 4, 6], reg_lambda in [1.0, 2.0, 5.0]
